economy.summary: His official legislative biography lists job creation as one of his top legislative goals and says he aims to ease the tax burden on Pennsylvanians and remove unnecessary regulations.
economy.short: Lists job creation as a top goal; aims to remove regulations.

taxes.summary: In his January 2026 re-election announcement he says he will continue to pursue legislation to eliminate property taxes, and cites fiscal responsibility as part of his record.
taxes.short: Continues pursuing legislation to eliminate property taxes.

abortion.summary: In December 2025 he voted against House Bill 1957, a proposed amendment to the Pennsylvania Constitution providing for personal reproductive liberty, which passed the House 102-101. His campaign announcement also lists 'life' among the issues on which he says he has a solid conservative record.
abortion.short: Voted against constitutional amendment providing for personal reproductive liberty.

healthcare.summary: His 2026 campaign says he seeks to establish medical freedom as a constitutional right in Pennsylvania, and points to his past work on COVID-19 emergency-powers legislation.
healthcare.short: Seeks to establish medical freedom as a constitutional right.

guns.summary: His 2026 re-election announcement lists 'firearms rights' among the issues on which he says he has maintained a solid conservative record; the announcement does not detail specific firearms proposals.
guns.short: Cites conservative record on firearms rights; no specific proposals detailed.

economy.summary: In his 2020 campaign for this same seat, he said he would work to raise the minimum wage so working Pennsylvanians can afford to live, and described strong unions as a necessary part of a thriving business environment. He has not published a 2026 platform.
economy.short: In 2020, said he would work to raise minimum wage.

taxes.summary: In his 2020 Ballotpedia candidate survey he called finding an equitable way to reduce school property taxes one of the state's greatest challenges, named a progressive tax approach as one possible solution, and said he would not support solutions that disproportionately target seniors or the working class.
taxes.short: In 2020, proposed equitably reducing school property taxes.

education.summary: In his 2020 Ballotpedia candidate survey he said he would fight for strong public education from K-16 through workforce training, and that he supports improving and increasing access to public education from pre-K through college and trade school.
education.short: In 2020, said he supports increasing public education access.
